answer: The marketplace escrows a maker's POA, refunds it when an offer expires untaken, and charges 100 basis points of the escrow as fee. Publish at each close R, the share of the book's escrowed POA that expired untaken, and count a head's answer only while it keeps its own live offer of at least R times the close's per-head challenge value, 341,530 at E128. That order is offered, not parked, so a taker can swap it away, and a farm's junk orders push R up, so its tenth head stands more than its first. A vine of open orders climbs past the horizon, and the knoll under it is demand nobody answered.
